name: When should I consider a roof repair versus a full roof replacement?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a roof repair versus a full roof replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between a repair and a full replacement depends on several factors, including the age of your roof, the extent of the damage, and the overall condition of the roofing material. If the damage is localized and your roof is relatively new, a repair is often sufficient. However, if your roof is nearing the end of its lifespan (typically 20-25 years for asphalt shingles) or has widespread damage, a replacement might be more cost-effective in the long run. We provide a professional assessment to help you make this decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose repair for localized damage on a newer roof; opt for replacement if the roof is old or has widespread damage. We provide assessments to guide your decision.
